notes.title: INCUBUS - Full Game Soundtrack and ‘Sounds of E.9.’ LP Released
notes.notes:
INCUBUS - Full [b]Game Soundtrack[/b] and ‘[b]Sounds of E.9[/b].’ LP Released

Delve deeper into INCUBUS with the unsettling, and disturbing, [b]game soundtrack[/b]. Things start off as normal, another day on the job 'ghost hunting' a normal looking house. A bit of London morning radio blends away as paranormal forces seep into the ambiance. The house is definitely haunted! The soundtrack blends elements of real-world modern London, with old Wartime Radio and the sounds generated by supernatural forces. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047870/376113b4bc30b27f3a5e449316ff2a2b2fa0de63.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047870/a6bfe536cf2568c9bb803da192e3e9174f7dda45.png[/img][/url]

[b]‘Sounds of E.9.[/b]

London DJ Zoe Cox introduces all the tracks heard in the ghost investigation game. Sounds of E9 is presented by DJ Zoe Cox and includes all day and night tracks from INCUBUS. 

📻 ‘This is Zoe Cox, with chat and bants, it’s time for some more music…’

notes.title: Update V1.08
notes.notes:
Update V1.08

Ratio overhaul. Interface screens (menus/inventory/etc) adapt for those running the game on alternative screens and resolutions. The game is designed to display at a ratio of 16:9. Black bars will pad around the game screen on Taller or Wider screens, with the interface systems constrained within the 16:9 game display.

Radio DJ, Zoe Cox, now introduces the songs playing on the airwaves - Plus new tracks have been added to her playlist, day and night.

Playback performance update for lower spec systems, many gamers are running under the recommended specs.
